body: 14 of the 110 people who opened your team settings this week tried to invite someone and the button did nothing — the request behind it failed every time. Most pressed it three times, then left.
messages.evidence: We think the workspace they belong to is missing on that path, in invite.tsx:41. It started the day PR #482 — Move invite sending behind the new workspace resolver — was merged. Nothing failed here in the nine days before it.
messages.forecast: If this is the only thing stopping them, we expect 1 in 8 more to finish setup.

body: We read 1,104 sessions yesterday and found nothing worth telling you. That is a normal day.
